verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 9641 Sunset Boulevard in Beverly Hills, in the 90210 zip code.
verified_facts.excerpt: We're at 9641 Sunset Boulevard, CA 90210, the original 90210, on Sunset Boulevard.

verified_facts.text: Rodeo Drive is about a 5-minute drive from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rodeo Drive is just a 5-minute drive away.

verified_facts.text: Los Angeles International Airport is around 30 to 40 minutes away.
verified_facts.excerpt: Los Angeles International Airport is around 30-40 minutes away.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits among 12 acres of tropical gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gather to celebrate in paradise surrounded by 12 acres of tropical gardens and exotic flowers.

verified_facts.text: Will Rogers Park is just across the street.
verified_facts.excerpt: For an off-leash jaunt, Will Rogers Park is just across the street.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is known as the 'Pink Palace'.
verified_facts.excerpt: For over a century, the 'Pink Palace' has been Hollywood's ultimate beacon of glamour, famous for its Polo Lounge, pool and spacious bungalows.

verified_facts.text: The pool dates back to 1938, when it opened as 'The Sand and Pool Club' with sand to make it feel like a beach club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our pool dates back to 1938 when it opened as ‘The Sand and Pool Club’, complete with sand to make it feel like a true beach club.

verified_facts.text: Leonard Bernstein came up with the idea for West Side Story in cabana 3.
verified_facts.excerpt: Katharine Hepburn once dove fully clothed into the pool, The Beatles had a private party here and Leonard Bernstein came up with the idea for West Side Story in cabana 3.

verified_facts.text: Bungalow rooms are set among the hotel's gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: The iconic bungalow rooms. Bathed in soft colours and the glow of history, and hidden amongst the timeless, tranquil gardens.

verified_facts.text: Bungalow 5 is outfitted in colors from Elizabeth Taylor's jewelry collection.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bungalow 5 is outfitted in colors from Elizabeth Taylor’s jewelry collection, including citrine and gold.

verified_facts.text: The Beverly Hills Suite includes complimentary round-trip airport transfers in a sedan-class car.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary round-trip airport transfers in a sedan-class car

verified_facts.text: The Polo Lounge has a candy-striped ceiling.
verified_facts.excerpt: Where else but the Polo Lounge could have a candy-striped ceiling and make it look effortlessly cool?

verified_facts.text: The Polo Lounge serves American cuisine with an Italian edge.
verified_facts.excerpt: American cuisine with an Italian edge and a specials board worthy of intense daily investigation.

verified_facts.text: The Polo Lounge lunch menu includes the McCarthy salad.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our lunch menu features some of our longstanding dishes, including the famed McCarthy salad.

verified_facts.text: A piano player plays at the Polo Lounge at lunch and dinner, and Sunday brunch on the patio comes with light jazz.
verified_facts.excerpt: Live music flows almost all day long, and a piano player serenades diners at lunch and dinner. On Sundays, brunch on the patio is accompanied by light jazz.

verified_facts.text: The Fountain Coffee Room has been serving since 1949.
verified_facts.excerpt: The iconic diner has been serving Hollywood stars since 1949 and you still never know who you might find yourself eating a slice of apple pie next to.

verified_facts.text: The Fountain Coffee Room is a 19-stool diner.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Fountain Coffee Room is a landmark 19-stool diner serving classic breakfast and lunch favourites until 4pm every day.

verified_facts.text: The Fountain Coffee Room seats customers at a curved bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: This diner seats its customers at the gloriously nostalgic, curved bar.

verified_facts.text: The Fountain Coffee Room breakfast includes silver dollar pancakes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Think freshly-squeezed orange juice, smoothies and a stack of our delicious silver dollar pancakes.

verified_facts.text: The Cabana Cafe is the hotel's al fresco poolside restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Cabana Cafe is The Beverly Hills Hotel's al fresco poolside restaurant.

verified_facts.text: The poolside cabanas have Apple TV, a mini fridge and lounge chairs.
verified_facts.excerpt: They're ready for the day, with a phone charging station, Apple TV, personal safe, mini fridge, bath robes, flat screen TV and lounge chairs.

verified_facts.text: The pool is heated year-round.
verified_facts.excerpt: Duck your head underwater, heated year-round to 82 degrees, and listen to tunes from classic films play while you swim.

verified_facts.text: The pool is family-friendly, and children under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
verified_facts.excerpt: It's family friendly, with no specific time slots. Please note that all children under the age of 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.

verified_facts.text: The spa's check-in area is positioned away from public spaces for privacy.
verified_facts.excerpt: our check-in area is positioned away from the public spaces so you can arrive and depart in complete privacy.

verified_facts.text: The spa has a duet suite, a nail suite and locker facilities with steam showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are multiple treatment rooms, a duet suite, nail suite, women's and men's locker facilities which include steam showers.

verified_facts.text: The Crystal Ballroom is an Art Deco space with rose chandeliers and French doors overlooking the Crystal Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: A glamorous Art Deco space with spectacular rose chandeliers and French doors overlooking the Crystal Garden and gazebo.

verified_facts.text: Up to two house-trained dogs up to 20 kilograms are permitted for a $150 fee per stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: We permit up to two fully house-trained dogs (max 20kg/45lbs) for a $150 fee per stay, with a special welcome treat and dog bed provided.

verified_facts.text: Cats are not permitted in the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are unable to permit cats in the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Parking is $70 per day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Parking is $70 per day.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is not automatically included in room rates.
verified_facts.excerpt: Breakfast is not automatically included.

verified_facts.text: Polo Lounge has a dress code that excludes baseball caps, flip-flops and sportswear.
verified_facts.excerpt: we encourage you to dress for the occasion, so ask that you refrain from wearing baseball caps
